idx_payments_unfulfilled.name: idx_payments_unfulfilled
idx_payments_unfulfilled.where: paid_at is not null and fulfilled_at is null

payments_tier_check.name: payments_tier_check
payments_tier_check.value: tier is null or tier in ('monthly', 'term', 'payg')

payments_target_check.name: payments_target_check
payments_target_check.value:
(
        purpose = 'booking' and booking_id is not null
          and player_id is null and lead_id is null and enrolment_id is null
      ) or (
        purpose = 'membership' and tier is not null
          and (player_id is null) <> (lead_id is null)
          and booking_id is null and enrolment_id is null
      ) or (
        purpose = 'class' and enrolment_id is not null
          and booking_id is null and player_id is null and lead_id is null
      )

players_level_check.name: players_level_check
players_level_check.value: level is null or level in ('Red ball', 'Green ball', 'Social', 'Club', 'Competitive', 'Open')

players_previous_level_check.name: players_previous_level_check
players_previous_level_check.value: previous_level is null or previous_level in ('Red ball', 'Green ball', 'Social', 'Club', 'Competitive', 'Open')
